items.text: Among adults having elective or emergency colorectal resection over 24 months, is full compliance with all applicable elements of the seven-element bundle, compared with incomplete compliance, associated with lower surgical site infection within 30 days including after discharge, after adjustment for emergency status, contamination, stoma, diabetes, obesity and operation length?
items.population: Adults having colorectal resection at the hospital, January 2027 to December 2028
items.intervention: Full compliance over applicable bundle elements (exposure)
items.outcome: Surgical site infection within 30 days by the surveillance definition

finer: Feasible with a two-minute form and existing surveillance; interesting to the working group; novel locally with post-discharge surveillance and emergency cases; ethical under the REB exemption; relevant to an infection rate above the regional average.
